speaker: CALLER
text: This call is from TRAI. Your mobile number will be disconnected within two hours due to illegal activity registered against it.

speaker: CALLER
text: Your Aadhaar is linked to a second SIM which has been used for harassment complaints. There is an FIR. I am transferring you to the cyber crime branch.

speaker: CALLER2
text: Sub Inspector speaking. Sir, this is a non bailable matter. An arrest warrant may be issued today.

speaker: CALLER2
text: We understand. But the case is confidential, please do not tell anyone, and do not disconnect the call. Keep your camera on. You are under surveillance until verification is complete.

speaker: CALLER2
text: For clearance you will need to transfer to this account for verification. It is a refundable amount held in a safe custody account. Also install this app, AnyDesk, and turn screen sharing on so our officer can verify your bank records.
